UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION

Form 10-Q Quarterly Report for the period ended March 31, 2026

Duke Energy Corporation

Debt and Credit Facilities — Term Loan Facilities

At March 31, 2026, Duke Energy Carolinas had $1.0 billion outstanding under its unsecured term loan facility due March 2027.

During the three months ended March 31, 2026, Duke Energy Corporation (Parent) repaid its $2.0 billion term loan.
